```{r print_text, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

pasta_pub_img <- sprintf('%s/imgs', getwd())
dir.create(pasta_pub_img, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("# ", params$title, "\n\n")
# cat("\\centering\n")  # This centers the content below
cat("\n\n")
for (block in params$text_blocks) {
  cat(block, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r first_image, out.width="100%", fig.align="center", fig.margin=FALSE}

if (file.exists(params$imagepath)) {
  # Copiar imagens para pasta temporária (para rodar quarto)
  img_local <- file.path(pasta_pub_img, basename(params$imagepath))
  if (!file.exists(img_local)) {
    file.copy(params$imagepath, img_local, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  
  # warning('Hara 0')
  # cat("\\vspace{0.1cm}\n")  # You can adjust '1cm' to whatever space is needed
  knitr::asis_output("\\vspace{-1cm}")  # Reduces space between the images
  knitr::include_graphics(img_local)
} else {
  cat("Image not found:", params$imagepath)
}
# # Add some vertical space (adjust the length as needed)
# cat("\\vspace{0.1cm}\n")  # You can adjust '1cm' to whatever space is needed
# knitr::include_graphics(params$imagepath)
```


```{r second_image, out.width="100%", fig.align="center", fig.margin=FALSE}

# Inserir segunda imagem, se coluna imagepath2 existir no dataframe
if ('imagepath2' %in% names(params) && file.exists(params$imagepath2)) {
  # Copiar imagens para pasta temporária (para rodar quarto)
  # warning('Hara 1')
  img_local2 <- file.path(pasta_pub_img, basename(params$imagepath2))
  if (!file.exists(img_local2)) {
    file.copy(params$imagepath2, img_local2, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  knitr::asis_output("\\vspace{-1cm}")  # Reduces space between the images
  knitr::asis_output("\\vskip -1cm")  # More direct control over vertical space
  knitr::include_graphics(img_local2)  # Display the second image
} else {
  # cat("Image not found:", params$imagepath2, "\n")
  cat("\n")
  # warning('Haro 2')
}
```
